audit_name: AURA Overnight Autonomous Full Product Rebuild

splash.behavior: Displays on cold boot with Platypi SemiBold typography, smooth 500ms fade/scale, 650ms hold, 350ms fadeout. Zero technical percentage loaders.

features: Curated daily outfit recommendation with Look 01/02/03 switcher
Direct navigation entries to Studio (/(tabs)/create), Try-On (/tryon), Online Discovery (/discovery), and Add Garment (/garment/add)
Filterable categories (all, tops, bottoms, outerwear, shoes, accessories)
Garment grid with clean transparent assets
Quick action to view detail, try on, or add clothing

studio.mental_model: Style my wardrobe with EditorialOutfitCanvas as the hero
studio.browsing: CurrentPieceBrowser single active piece swipe carousel; zero permanent 3-row database cards

modes.build: User controls outfit pieces and swipes active slot
modes.aura: AURA proposes curated complete looks from existing wardrobe pieces

studio.live_intelligence: liveStyleIntelligenceService evaluates outfit harmony, color contrast, and palette instantaneously on swipe

online_discovery.retailers: Supported retailer Myntra via ProductSourceProvider architecture
online_discovery.flow: Paste product link -> Finding your item... -> Product found -> Actual product image -> Garment isolation -> [ TRY IT ON ] / [ ADD TO CLOSET ]
online_discovery.fallback: Honest fallback: Couldn't import this product. Try uploading the product image instead. Direct image and screenshot upload supported with GarmentRegionSelector manual fallback.
online_discovery.scraping_governance: Zero unauthorized web scraping, zero bot bypassing, zero Pinterest crawling

try_on.personal_model: Integrated with persistent Personal AURA Model avatar, proportions, and sizes
try_on.honesty: When on-device neural diffusion weights are in development, honestly reports engine_unavailable state with preparation message. Zero fake AI renders.

steps: Step 1: Proportions (Height, Weight, optional measurements with fit rationale)
Step 2: Usual Sizes (Tops XS-3XL, Bottoms, Shoes)
Step 3: Body Shape (Straight, Athletic, Broader Shoulders, Fuller Midsection, Curved Frame - neutral phrasing)
Step 4: Face References (Identity appearance strictly distinct from body measurements; clear privacy notice)
Step 5: Model Ready (Persistent model activation, stored locally on-device)
personal_aura_model.privacy: Sensitive biometrics kept strictly in local private storage; zero external logging

features: GarmentRegionSelector with 52x52 touch handles and confidence gate 0.65
Parent scroll lock during crop interaction (onInteractionStart / onInteractionEnd)

figma_visual_qa.source_of_truth_used: Local canvas.fig screen schema strings and docs/04-design-system.md design tokens
figma_visual_qa.typography: Platypi SemiBold (display), Lora Bold/Regular (editorial titles), Inter (functional UI)
figma_visual_qa.color_palette: Curated warm neutrals, cream tones, subtle borders, high contrast accents. Zero generic black card stacking.

garment_pipeline_integrity.source_preservation: Actual garment source is preserved; zero synthetic clothing invention

performance.image_loading: Optimized local transparent assets, no base64 bloat
